environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2 in us-east-1, VPC with public subnet. Flask 1.1.4 with Werkzeug 1.0.1 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only - no HTTP inspection). Instance role has s3:PutObject on the logging bucket. No WAF attached. Security group allows inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs directly via gunicorn with no reverse proxy performing header validation.
